_doc: Flipbook hit effects (FlipbookView, src/view/flipbook_view.gd). View only: not read by the sim and not in the online data hash. effects: one strip per name in assets/sprites/vfx/ (frames side by side, cut by tools/cut_packs.py from kiddolink's VFX pack: ASSETS-LICENSES.md), its frame count, frame size and ticks per frame. moves: '<fighter id>/<move slot>' -> effect played on each hit of that move; flip 'face' mirrors it when the attacker faces left; lift moves it up (px); replace (default true) drops FxView's own burst for that hit, keeping its pixels, flash and shake.
